UPTIME(1) General Commands Manual UPTIME(1)

NAME

uptime — show how long system has been running

SYNOPSIS

uptime [--libxo]

DESCRIPTION

The uptime utility displays the current time, the length of time the system has been up, the number of users, and the load average of the system over the last 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

The following options are available:

--libxo
Generate output via libxo(3) in a selection of different human and machine readable formats. See xo_options(7) for details on command line arguments.

EXAMPLES

$ uptime
11:23AM  up  3:01, 8 users, load averages: 21.09, 15.43, 12.79

SEE ALSO

w(1), libxo(3), xo_options(7)

HISTORY

The uptime command appeared in 3.0BSD.
